title: TMS – Luồng API
description: Lưu lượng, lỗi và độ trễ của mọi endpoint: qua API Gateway và trong từng service.

panels.title: Service đang chạy
panels.description: Số app Prometheus scrape được (tối đa 6: gateway + 5 service).

targets.expr: sum(up{job="tms"})
sum(rate(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_count{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(increase(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_count{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__range]))

(sum(rate(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_count{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_count{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Đang xử lý
panels.description: Request đang được xử lý ở mọi app (không tính /api đang proxy ở gateway).

targets.expr: sum(http_server_requests_in_flight{job="tms"})
up{job="tms", service=~"$service"}

panels.title: Luồng truy cập qua API Gateway (client → gateway → service)
Request / s theo service đích
panels.description: `target` = service nhận request sau gateway; `gateway` = gateway tự trả lời (401 thiếu token, 403, 404, 429 rate limit, 501).

targets.expr: sum by (target) (rate(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_count{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (status) (rate(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_count{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Tất cả endpoint qua gateway
panels.description: Mỗi dòng là một endpoint (route template: id được thay bằng :id). Số liệu tính trên khoảng thời gian đang chọn ở góc phải. Bấm tiêu đề cột để sắp xếp, icon phễu để lọc.

targets.expr: sum by (method, route, target) (increase(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_count{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__range]))
sum by (method, route, target) (rate(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_count{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__range]))

(sum by (method, route, target) (increase(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_count{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", status=~"5.."}[$__range])) or (0 * sum by (method, route, target) (increase(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_count{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__range])))) / sum by (method, route, target) (increase(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_count{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__range]))

(sum by (method, route, target) (increase(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_count{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", status=~"4.."}[$__range])) or (0 * sum by (method, route, target) (increase(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_count{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__range])))) / sum by (method, route, target) (increase(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_count{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__range]))

sum by (method, route, target) (increase(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_sum{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__range])) / sum by (method, route, target) (increase(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_count{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (method, route, target, le) (increase(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (method, route, target, le) (increase(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (method, route, target, le) (increase(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__range])))
topk(10, sum by (method, route) (rate(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_count{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (method, route, le) (rate(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))
sum by (method, route, status) (rate(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_count{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", status=~"[45].."}[$__rate_interval]))
histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(tms_gateway_requests_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Endpoint trong từng service (gồm cả gọi nội bộ /internal/**)
Request / s theo service
panels.description: Mọi request mà service trả lời: từ gateway và từ service khác (/internal/**). Không tính /health, /metrics, /docs.

targets.expr: sum by (service) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{service=~"$service", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (service, le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", route=~"$route", method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Gọi đồng bộ giữa các service (/internal/**)
panels.description: Service nhận (`→ service`) của các lời gọi nội bộ: ví dụ class-service hỏi student-service, student-service hỏi billing-service.

targets.expr: sum by (service, method, route, status) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{service=~"$service", route=~"/internal/.*"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (service, method, route, status) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{service=~"$service", route=~"$route", method=~"$method", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Luồng sự kiện bất đồng bộ (outbox → RabbitMQ → consumer)

targets.expr: sum by (service) (rate(tms_outbox_published_total{service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (service, event_type) (rate(tms_events_consumed_total{service=~"$service", outcome="handled"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (service, event_type, outcome) (rate(tms_events_consumed_total{service=~"$service", outcome!="handled"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: RabbitMQ: message đang chờ trong queue
panels.description: Queue tăng liên tục nghĩa là consumer xử lý không kịp hoặc đang lỗi.

targets.expr: sum by (queue) (rabbitmq_queue_messages_ready{job="rabbitmq"})
sum by (queue) (rabbitmq_queue_messages_unacked{job="rabbitmq"})
rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{job="tms", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval])
